name: Video Embed Rutube
description: Video Embed Field integration with Rutube.
project_description:
This module provides Rutube handler for Video Embed Field .

Users can add Rutube videos to their site by pasting the video's URL into a video embed field.

in the setting users can set width and height and also autoplay option of the video.

This module also can get thumbnail image from Rutube website for using it as a teaser image.

 Requires:

 Video Embed Field 

 Compatibility 
 
 Drupal >=10.3 & 11 
 
Video Embed Rutube 3.0 supports Drupal >=10.3 & 11 and compitable with Video Embed Field 3

 
 
 Drupal >=9.2 & 10 
 
Video Embed Rutube 8.x-1.5 supports Drupal >=9.2 & 10 and compitable with Video Embed Field 8.x-2.5
